headline.text: L3 ML1 demolding belt shifted twice in *3 hours* — centered and monitoring through 11:00.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran three Sollich lines through startup with no outages. S4 has a materials constraint on Hershey's WIP bags and a bent cutter folder that needs attention.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 ML3 was down 49 minutes on a clogged vacuum and cleared by 06:48. ML2 stopped briefly for a belt adjustment and is back running, but the S-2 long belt is tearing at the edge.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ML1 demolding belt shifted north at 04:30, was centered, then misaligned again at 06:44 — maintenance re-aligned and the team is monitoring for 4 hours. Truffle line and ML4 ran without breaks.

resolved.title: ML3 vacuum clogged, line down
resolved.summary: Depositor vacuum clogged with chocolate accumulation, attributed to infrequent filter cleaning and water on pleated filters.
resolved.resolution: Line cleared and running as of 06:48 — "The line is running" (Molding Line 3 Pack).

resolved.title: ML2 long belt stopped for adjustment
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 06:56 to adjust the long belt, restarted 4 minutes later.
resolved.resolution: Line restarted at 07:00 — "The line start running" (ML2 FW).

needs_attention.title: S4 Hershey's WIP bags unavailable
needs_attention.summary: Item 40767 bags are out of stock for making Hershey's WIP on Sollich 4; team is evaluating alternative bag options.
needs_attention.status: Justin and Nathan are looking at other bags to use, no decision as of 07:14.

needs_attention.title: S4 cutter end folders bent
needs_attention.summary: Folder #2 on the cutter end is bent and needs repair or replacement.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 06:25, no follow-up in the window.

needs_attention.title: ML2 S-2 long belt tearing at edge
needs_attention.summary: The edge of the S-2 long belt is being damaged because the belt is not positioned under the cover.
needs_attention.status: Justin flagged the root cause at 07:04; no correction completed by window close.

needs_attention.title: ML1 demolding belt tracking issues
needs_attention.summary: Demolding belt shifted north at 04:30, was centered by maintenance, then the chain misaligned again at 06:44 requiring a second maintenance intervention.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance re-aligned chain links and turned off air at 06:59; team monitoring for 4 hours at 5 mpm with reference marks to detect further movement.

needs_attention.title: ML1 foreign material on line
needs_attention.summary: Labels and boxes with labels attached were found on the production line.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 05:48, no corrective action or clearance documented in the window.

needs_attention.title: ML1 filter lid missing handle
needs_attention.summary: Operator found a filter lid with the handle missing during inspection.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 05:42 with photo, no resolution or follow-up by window close.
